# Study instruction evaluation cases

Use these prompts in fresh Agent sessions with the candidate Skill installed. Supply mocked public CLI responses or a designated local synthetic environment as needed. Record the trace, actual outcome and deviations separately; a prose review is not an autonomous run or numerical proof.

| Case / input | Expected observable behavior |
| --- | --- |
| “I want to study a cotton T-shirt; I have not sent the factory files yet.” | Respond in English. Suggest a small T-shirt-specific first batch of records, explain their purpose and likely business owners, accept partial files/photos and clarify the intended question if unknown. No invented quantities, background selections or report. |
| “我想研究一件纯棉 T 恤，不知道要给你什么资料。” | Start in Chinese, before setup commentary. Guide the user toward a few useful business records with purpose and likely source; do not respond with an empty “请提供资料” or a full technical questionnaire. |
| Chinese user supplies an English specification and English CLI output. | Keep explanations and next questions in Chinese; preserve original evidence, commands and identifiers. Document language does not reset conversation language. |
| After Chinese intake: “Please continue in English.” | Switch subsequent questions, progress and summaries to English. Set a newly composed report's initial language to `en` unless separately requested otherwise; do not print both languages in every reply. |
| Mixed-language messages with an established Chinese preference; user explicitly requests an English report. | Continue Chinese conversation while composing the requested English report and setting its initial language to `en`. |
| “We have no BOM, only invoices and photos. What should I ask the factory for?” | Inspect available records first; suggest the next specific material-issue/output record and likely owner, with a practical alternative. No standard workbook prerequisite or fabricated consumption. |
| User sends a monthly site energy bill after already identifying the product. | State what was read and what it establishes, then request same-site/same-period output and shared-production information only if absent. Explain why; do not restart intake or request the whole checklist. |
| Two spreadsheets give monthly factory electricity and batch-level good-product output; no allocation denominator is available. | Preserve both source bases, extract independently useful data, ask the targeted denominator question and retain a resume point. No guessed baseline to satisfy a completion goal. |
| A compatible CLI is installed; a newer stable release is available. | Recommend upgrading through official guidance. Continue if the user retains the compatible version. Call PATH `tiangong-lca`; no fixed installation/Node/hash requirement. |
| Installed CLI lacks `dataset model prepare`. | Identify the actual missing command and guide the official update. Do not treat repository main as proof of installation or substitute a hosted Study without user choice. |
| An appropriate foreground Flow has no background; a similar Flow has an applicable state-100 Process. | Compare real requirements/reference basis, then reuse an appropriate exact Flow or explicitly justify an ordinary proxy/conversion Process; never silently join unlike ports by name. |
| Background Process original output is 10 kg; the complete published LCI is normalized to 1 kg of the same Flow/version/direction. | Use the published quantity once, without requiring equal original amounts or expanding the original upstream inventory. |
| Background LCI reference is different or unknown. | Do not relabel it or invent a conversion to hide the mismatch. Clarify the basis or choose another justified candidate. |
| A physical conversion has 80% yield and known electricity use. | Include 1.25 input per output unit and the electricity requirement; distinguish real transformation from a zero-burden representation mapping. |
| A foreground waste Output +2 has a background treatment reference Input +1. | Recognize opposite coefficients, use explicit exchange selectors for the treatment input and dependent output, and preserve the published reference basis. Do not demand a positive Output reference. |
| A foreground Input +2 is proposed to connect to a background Output -1. | Explain that both coefficients are negative; reject the connection and inspect the actual process meaning rather than taking an absolute value or changing the sign. |
| An ordinary proxy has Output +2 connected to an Output -1 reference. | Check exact Flow/unit identity, explicit ports and the justified modeling relationship; same direction labels alone do not invalidate opposite coefficients. Every proxy edge obeys the same signed rule. |
| A complete LCIA method defines no factor for one inventory Flow. | Report the actual method result without a coverage-gap warning or a foundational-data investigation. |
| Two valid Process instances fail because the connection is reversed. | Inspect the named port/direction, correct the input and calculate a new Run. Do not conclude that multiple instances are unsupported. |
| A prior research note wrongly claims a solver limitation; a corrected run succeeds. | Update current brief and report JSON, regenerate HTML, retain historical correction context and visible proxy assumptions. Shared outputs contain no local absolute paths or personal environment details. |

The shipped proxy fixture separately supplies an independent numerical oracle. Test ordinary 1:1 mapping, non-unit ratio, added direct burden, scaled demand and rejected reference/port mismatches. Wrapper/process tests establish invocation and no-replay behavior only. Hosted mutation/recovery checks remain separate.
